source.title_or_context: Recommendations for specialized diagnostic tests for selected patients with chronic heart failure to detect reversible/treatable causes of heart failure

table_assessment.assessment_notes: Isolated diagnostic-testing recommendation table with 12 assertion-bearing rows across five section headers.

entities.surface_form: those with poor echocardiogram acoustic windows

normative_assertions.notes: CMR performance is recommended for the stated assessment and population.

text_units.verbatim_text: CMR is recommended for the assessment of myocardial structure and function in those with poor echocardiogram acoustic windows.

normative_assertions.notes: All listed disease contexts are retained as applicability conditions for myocardial-tissue characterization by CMR.

text_units.verbatim_text: CMR is recommended for the characterization of myocardial tissue in suspected infiltrative disease, Fabry disease, inflammatory disease (myocarditis), LV non-compaction, amyloid, sarcoidosis, iron overload/haemochromatosis.

normative_assertions.notes: Diagnostic purpose is retained as a parameter, not converted into a factual accuracy claim.

text_units.verbatim_text: CMR with LGE should be considered in DCM to distinguish between ischaemic and non-ischaemic myocardial damage.

header_path: Invasive coronary angiography (in those who are considered eligible for potential coronary revascularization)

normative_assertions.notes: The two alternative clinical conditions and failed-therapy context are preserved without conflating them.

text_units.verbatim_text: Invasive coronary angiography is recommended in patients with angina despite pharmacological therapy or symptomatic ventricular arrhythmias. 5

entities.surface_form: intermediate to high pre-test probability of CAD

header_path: Invasive coronary angiography (in those who are considered eligible for potential coronary revascularization)

normative_assertions.notes: Explicit may wording supports permissive force; all conjunctive eligibility criteria are retained.

text_units.verbatim_text: Invasive coronary angiography may be considered in patients with HFrEF with an intermediate to high pre-test probability of CAD and the presence of ischaemia in non-invasive stress tests. 89

entities.surface_form: low to intermediate pre-test probability of CAD

normative_assertions.notes: Alternative pre-test/stress-test criteria and rule-out purpose are retained as parameters.

text_units.verbatim_text: CTCA should be considered in patients with a low to intermediate pre-test probability of CAD or those with equivocal non-invasive stress tests in order to rule out coronary artery stenosis.

entities.surface_form: Non-invasive stress imaging (CMR, stress echocardiography, SPECT, PET)

normative_assertions.notes: Explicit may wording supports permissive force; assessment targets and revascularization suitability remain parameters.

text_units.verbatim_text: Non-invasive stress imaging (CMR, stress echocardiography, SPECT, PET) may be considered for the assessment of myocardial ischaemia and viability in patients with CAD who are considered suitable for coronary revascularization. 90–93

normative_assertions.notes: Both diagnostic purposes are retained without inferring factual test performance.

text_units.verbatim_text: Exercise testing may be considered to detect reversible myocardial ischaemia and investigate the cause of dyspnoea. 94–96

normative_assertions.notes: The test is part of evaluation for either listed advanced-therapy pathway.

text_units.verbatim_text: Cardiopulmonary exercise testing is recommended as a part of the evaluation for heart transplantation and/or MCS. 94–96

normative_assertions.notes: Optimization purpose is retained as a parameter.

text_units.verbatim_text: Cardiopulmonary exercise testing should be considered to optimize prescription of exercise training. 94–96

normative_assertions.notes: Both alternative symptom contexts are retained.

text_units.verbatim_text: Cardiopulmonary exercise testing should be considered to identify the cause of unexplained dyspnoea and/or exercise intolerance. 94–96

normative_assertions.notes: Evaluation for either advanced-therapy pathway is retained as an applicability parameter.

text_units.verbatim_text: Right heart catheterization is recommended in patients with severe HF being evaluated for heart transplantation or MCS.
